name: 🍚 Kitchen-Sink Grain Bowls
what: A grain, a protein, two veggies, something crunchy and a dressing. Use up the fridge.
early: Optional, Sunday: cook the quinoa; it keeps 5 days.

core.name: A protein: leftover chicken or steak
Olive oil + vinegar dressing
core.out: ranch, or any dressing we have

extras: beans, cheese, pumpkin seeds or almonds, dijon, honey

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Rinse 1 cup quinoa, simmer covered in 2 cups salted water.
Shake ¼ cup oil, 2 Tbsp vinegar, mustard, honey, salt in a jar.
Grain on the bottom, toppings on top, dressing and crunch last.

key: It's a formula, not a recipe: grain + protein + 2 veggies + crunch + sauce.
done: Quinoa is fluffy and the little white tails show.
plan_b: No grain? Pile it all on lettuce for a big salad.
